description: Wide/deep stern section with the M1 wheel pocket and housing, helm on deck. 25% wider deck than W1-r2; keel lowered to -2.75.
boundsNote: Measured 2026-09-25 (WideHullValidation): union of the module's FBX vertex bounds, converted to authoring axes by the measured Blender-reimport rotation (authoring.x=-measured.y, authoring.y=measured.x, authoring.z=measured.z; verified against manifest AftSocket/ForwardSocket and against W1-r2's identical fitting heights, e.g. this stern's max Z 3.652 matches Stern_W1's exactly).

sockets.notes: Aft end of the ship; the module origin.
Axle centre. Standard M1 wheel socket unchanged from W1-r2 (kit README). Rotor and carrier are placed here; rotate the rotor only, about game X.
Kit README: chimney base centre at the assembled ship midpoint, Z = 1.76 (deck), same rule and fitting geometry as W1-r2.

equipmentSlots.notes: Clearance = the REAL cannon footprint (art-staging/cannon-astra-v1: 1.22 wide x 2.18 long x 1.28 high), verified by WideHullValidation against this section's bounds and its crew passage (touches, does not overlap). Main-deck slots stay PROVISIONAL: the kit's deck-slot empties do not certify cannon clearance (kit README).

Clearance = the REAL cannon footprint (art-staging/cannon-astra-v1: 1.22 wide x 2.18 long x 1.28 high), verified by WideHullValidation against this section's bounds and its crew passage (touches, does not overlap). Main-deck slots stay PROVISIONAL: the kit's deck-slot empties do not certify cannon clearance (kit README).

passages.notes: W2 has no authored crew passages (kit README); derived from W1-r2's passage rule scaled to the W2 deck (docs/WIDE-HULL-VALIDATION.md): |y| <= the deck-slot Y (4.35) minus half the real cannon's width (1.22/2=0.61) = 3.74, so sizeU.y = 7.48. X span unchanged from W1-r2 (3.16, the forward edge of the wheel housing ironwork, to 9.30): the kit keeps housing/ironwork sizes unchanged. Height 3.4 u = 1.7 m crew (WorldScale.Person) at 0.5 m/u, unaffected by beam/keel.

hydrostatics.notes: Astra 2026-09-24 (art-staging/modular-hull-wide-v1/hydrostatics/Stern_W2.json): Hull_Shell only, upright level flotation.

lightship.rule: Seeded 2026-09-25 (WideHullValidation): today's W1-r2 Long lightship (31906.6 kg) x the W2/W1 Long hydrostatic-table volume-to-deck ratio (940.54 / 611.67 U^3 = 1.5377), split by this section's own table volume to the deck (381.30 / 940.54 U^3). Volume ratio chosen over hull-shell surface-area ratio (1.2532): at the resulting mass the ship floats at 46.2% of keel-to-deck depth at lightship, matching W1-r2 Long's 45.9% almost exactly, so the loaded FRACTION of the (now much deeper) hull is preserved; the surface-area ratio gives 38.9%, a visibly different loading fraction. See docs/WIDE-HULL-VALIDATION.md.

holdCells.source: round(this section's table volume-to-deck (381.30 U^3) / W1-r2's volume-per-hold-cell (611.67/16=38.229 U^3))

berths.source: floor(W1-r2 stern's 2 berths x the W2/W1 deck-area ratio 11.60/9.28=1.25)

gunSlots.source: Both slots pass the real-cannon clearance/passage check (WideHullValidation); this is the same DeckSlot index W1-r2's stern designates, kept for consistency (no existing W2 ship to match a gun position to).

capacity.rule: Seeded 2026-09-25 (WideHullValidation), mirroring the W1-r2 A4 seeding: PROVISIONAL, tune freely; the shipyard sums whatever is here.

physical.notes: NOT AUTHORED. Must not be inferred from mesh size, section length or wheel radius.
